## Who may be a good fit

::: {.fit-list}

**Students and clinical trainees** able to contribute consistently to data analysis or scientific writing.
:::

## What to send

- Your CV and a two- or three-sentence note describing your interests and goals.
- Your realistic time commitment, plus a relevant writing sample, project link, or GitHub profile if available.
